name: qkh_lane8_ref_c-q13d-COMMIT
purpose: TP8 qkd_rhead slot fit (648 x 453.6, 128 inst): the closed 4 x 4 head_hs cluster is 734.4 x 855.36 (+43 mm2 on the die). Lane leaf variant c = same RTL top ot_qkh_lane8, 108 x 151.2 (synth std 8,754 um2 -> util 0.575 of the 103.68 x 146.88 core), M5 cap, all signal pins + rst_n on E, clk on W; own local clock root (~13.1k sinks)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkh_lane8 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_subtiles.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_prod.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: layer_hs_mut
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && HSUB=1 HSMUT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/hs_neg 0

bench.name: anr7
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/anr7.vvp -s tb_hdc_add_lat_nr -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.LAT=7 -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.HMUT=0 rtl/test/tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/anr7.vvp

bench.name: anr7_mut
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/anr7_mut.vvp -s tb_hdc_add_lat_nr -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.LAT=7 -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.HMUT=1 rtl/test/tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/anr7_mut.vvp

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkh_lane8_ref_c/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkh_lane8_ref_c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkh_lane8_ref_c --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkh_lane8  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: lane leaf re-shaped 129.6 x 129.6 -> 108 x 151.2 (6 x 3 slot grid of the TP8 qkd_rhead slot 648 x 453.6) with every signal pin and rst_n on ONE face (E; MY gives W) so 16 lanes pack around a relay hub without the 43.2 um channels of the 4 x 4 parent
